title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Tech ripped, energy bled, small caps sat out.
Nasdaq led as oil's 4% slide and AI-chip optimism powered semis and mega-cap comms; SPY's 1.2x volume confirms real accumulation, not a squeeze. But breadth is a mirage — only 49% of S&P names hold their 200-DMA and just 29% their 50-DMA, so this is a narrow tape, with size and value money rotating into semis while broad-market ETFs bleed.

INDICES — VIX 14.9, below its 20-day 15.7.
SOXX +4.93%, QQQ +2.77%, SPY +1.55%, DIA +0.76%, IWM +0.52%, with SLV -0.50% and GLD -0.70%. Large beat small by 2.25pp. WTI (USO) -3.68% is the standout cross-asset move; both SPY and QQQ sit comfortably above their 200-day MAs.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 1.2x and QQQ 1.5x, both elevated with price up: accumulation. Uptrend is real but concentrated — XLC 1.9x and XLK 1.4x gained attention while XLY 0.8x, XLP 0.9x, and XLB 0.9x were ignored. Breadth: 291/208 advancers, 2.10 up/down volume ratio, but only 11 new 60-day highs vs 71 lows — participation clearly diverges from the index move.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLC Comms +3.56%, XLK Tech +2.77%, XLY Discretionary +1.08%, XLV Health +0.37%, XLRE Real Estate +0.14%, XLI Industrials +0.00%, XLF Financials +0.00%, XLE Energy +0.00%, XLB Materials -0.56%, XLP Staples -1.06%, XLU Utilities -1.07%.
Top industries: IBIT +6.50%, SOXX +4.93%; bottom: XOP -3.07%, USO -3.68% (FCG -2.04%). Flows: XLY +$711mm (100th pct) and XLC +$133mm gained, while XLE -$879mm (2nd pct) and XLF -$697mm (17th pct) bled — leaders on both list and screen, so this is real rotation into comms and semis, not short-covering. Rotation state: narrow mega-cap tape.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.82, QQQ 0.97: modest, not fearful. SPY skew +4.5%, QQQ +5.9% — put premium present but muted. VIXEQ 38.7 versus VIX 14.9 is the widest gap on the board: high single-stock dispersion and low implied correlation — a rotation tape, not a macro-driven one.

CROSS-ASSET — WTI (USO) -3.68% and crude futures -4.29% hit energy while lifting tech risk appetite; the dollar (UUP +0.32%) still pressured gold (GLD -0.70%) — a headwind for precious metals even with equities bid. TLT +0.68% and IEF +0.39% reflect a curve flattening of -0.05%. Next FOMC is Oct 28, 2026: Polymarket prices 52% for a 25bp hike (5d +7pp) and 46% for no change (5d -6pp).

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 48.5, Neutral.
Top movers: INTC +12.14% (SK Hynix exploring an Ohio lease), META +11.34%, AMD +9.95% (AI-cooperation optimism), all with 2.3-2.6x vol spikes — accumulation, not distribution. UNP -3.49% on 2.5x volume is the outlier distribution print. Watch QQQE +2.44% at 2.7x volume (broad-tech breadth test), MAGS +3.56% at 3.3x (mega-cap concentration risk), and FNGS +2.55% at 2.3x for follow-through vs. exhaustion.
